p3_findings.title: Freeze hashes lack type-domain separation
p3_findings.reason: Changing existing digest prefixes would invalidate retained receipts and needs an explicit schema migration rather than an in-place repair.
p3_findings.residual_risk: Identical bytes and canonical JSON can share a digest even though callers intend different semantic domains.
p3_findings.next_test: Design schema 2.0 with file and JSON domain prefixes, migration vectors and verification of retained schema 1.0 receipts.

p3_findings.title: Canonical JSON mishandled undefined members and array holes
p3_findings.reason: Future optional values could make the written JSON and the hashed canonical projection disagree.
p3_findings.residual_risk: The canonicaliser covers the freeze data model, not every possible JavaScript object or custom toJSON implementation.
p3_findings.next_test: Repeat undefined object, undefined array, sparse array and unsupported primitive vectors in an independent runtime.

p3_findings.title: Freeze manifests were written non-atomically
p3_findings.reason: An interrupted direct write could leave a truncated review receipt at its final path.
p3_findings.residual_risk: Filesystem and hardware durability still depend on the host honoring fsync and atomic same-directory rename semantics.
p3_findings.next_test: Inject write and rename failures and confirm no partial final file or abandoned temporary file remains.

p3_findings.title: Legacy raw-input verifier accepted absolute paths
p3_findings.reason: A hostile retained manifest could select arbitrary host files before hashing and transformation.
p3_findings.residual_risk: Closed paths constrain file selection but do not authenticate the retained bytes or their claimed publisher.
p3_findings.next_test: Try absolute, parent traversal and symlink escape paths from a copied manifest in a clean checkout.

p3_findings.title: CI actions used moving major tags
p3_findings.reason: Moving action tags can change executed CI code without a repository diff.
p3_findings.residual_risk: Pinned action bytes still rely on GitHub-hosted execution and require deliberate updates for security fixes.
p3_findings.next_test: Replace either action SHA with a moving tag and confirm the governance test rejects the workflow.

p3_findings.title: Lifecycle proposals hid the action-gate basis state
p3_findings.reason: False, unknown and stale action gates could produce the same continue-active proposal without preserving why.
p3_findings.residual_risk: A machine proposal remains advisory and cannot determine whether an existing action should legally or ethically continue.
p3_findings.next_test: Evaluate active lifecycles under true, false, unknown, stale and conflicted gates and compare the retained basis states.

p3_findings.title: Synthetic provenance identifiers were unconstrained
p3_findings.reason: Synthetic fixtures could be relabelled with real-looking agencies while keeping a synthetic classification constant.
p3_findings.residual_risk: Identifier patterns prevent casual relabelling but do not authenticate who produced any observation.
p3_findings.next_test: Replace synthetic source, recorder and schema identifiers with agency-like values and require schema rejection.

p3_findings.title: Legacy semantic validation looked authoritative but was advisory
p3_findings.reason: The module returned findings but no production build path treated them as a mandatory acceptance gate.
p3_findings.residual_risk: Callers can still misuse an advisory validator if they ignore its documented scope and return value.
p3_findings.next_test: Trace every import and verify no public build claims that advisory semantic validation is an enforced gate.

p3_findings.title: Non-closed claims did not require a current accepting review
p3_findings.reason: Expired or rejected reviews could coexist with an open claim disposition without invalidating the ledger.
p3_findings.residual_risk: Review records and their clocks remain claimed data without an authenticated external reviewer registry.
p3_findings.next_test: Try only rejected, expired and accepted-with-conditions reviews at their exact validity boundaries.

p3_findings.title: Supported claims could rely only on contradictory context
p3_findings.reason: The claim ledger did not port the direct-evidence ceiling already enforced by the ceiling validator.
p3_findings.residual_risk: A direct evidence link can still be weak, biased or misinterpreted without domain review.
p3_findings.next_test: Build supported claims with only context, contradiction or assumption links and require direct supporting evidence.

p3_findings.title: Blank NERO numeric cells became zero
p3_findings.reason: JavaScript numeric coercion could fabricate a decline when a future source vintage suppressed a value.
p3_findings.residual_risk: Other source-specific suppression tokens may still require explicit policy when new vintages arrive.
p3_findings.next_test: Inject blank, whitespace, nonnumeric and source suppression tokens and verify the audit fails visibly.

p3_findings.title: Occupation classification version was asserted as verified
p3_findings.reason: The frozen baseline hardcoded a classification version while its source documentation called the version unverified.
p3_findings.residual_risk: An explicit unverified status is honest but still blocks classification-dependent interpretation.
p3_findings.next_test: Attempt to run the engine with missing, contradictory and falsely verified classification status values.

p3_findings.title: Forecast ceilings omitted input provenance class
p3_findings.reason: The invented 62 percent fixture could be copied out of context as if it were an empirical estimate.
p3_findings.residual_risk: Visible fixture labels reduce ambiguity but cannot prevent selective quotation after export.
p3_findings.next_test: Render forecast ceilings and cohort reports from mixed provenance inputs and verify every class remains explicit.

p3_findings.title: Forecast retrieval clocks were not compared to the vintage cutoff
p3_findings.reason: The current mature-record schema cannot represent per-input retrieval clocks, so the intended cutoff boundary needed to be explicit.
p3_findings.residual_risk: A post-cutoff retrieval can remain structurally valid until the schema carries per-input acquisition timing.
p3_findings.next_test: Add per-input retrieval clocks in a versioned schema and reject any input first acquired after issuance cutoff.

p3_findings.title: Standalone decision chronology allowed equal timestamps
p3_findings.reason: Decision and final attestation could share an instant even though integrated lineage required strict ordering.
p3_findings.residual_risk: Strict string chronology does not authenticate the clock or prove deliberation occurred in that order.
p3_findings.next_test: Try decision times before, equal to and after the final attestation and require only strict succession.

p3_findings.title: Deliberation records could predate the evaluated IF receipt
p3_findings.reason: Positions, dissent and attestations could be recorded before the condition state they purported to deliberate.
p3_findings.residual_risk: Internal chronology still relies on caller-supplied timestamps and cannot prove when deliberation happened.
p3_findings.next_test: Move each deliberation timestamp across the receipt evaluation boundary and require typed rejection.

p3_findings.title: Signature, clock and chain authentication boundaries were hidden
p3_findings.reason: Record-level results could be read as authentication even though signatures and clocks are only caller-bound claims.
p3_findings.residual_risk: No local schema can authenticate identity, mandate, signature, wall clock or an external append-only registry.
p3_findings.next_test: Confirm every valid result exposes context_authenticated false and no documentation upgrades hash consistency to authentication.

p3_findings.title: Governance records omitted challenge, stop, remedy and mandate controls
p3_findings.reason: Affected parties could not structurally identify a challenge route, authorised stop invoker, remedy owner or expiring representation mandate.
p3_findings.residual_risk: Named synthetic controls do not establish that a real route works, an invoker can act or a remedy is adequate.
p3_findings.next_test: Delete, expire or collapse each control and verify negotiation, decision and lineage fail before activation.

p3_findings.title: Fully resolved negotiation was unrepresentable
p3_findings.reason: A nonempty unresolved-dissent constraint accidentally encoded permanent disagreement rather than a deliberate fail-closed rule.
p3_findings.residual_risk: An empty unresolved set proves only record consistency, not fair resolution or genuine consent.
p3_findings.next_test: Exercise fully resolved, withdrawn, accepted and still-blocking dissent across negotiation and decision records.

p3_findings.title: Consultation detail was hidden behind a nondefault tab
p3_findings.reason: Population-level not-consulted status was less visible than model states on the initial Observatory view.
p3_findings.residual_risk: Visibility does not substitute for actual consultation, representation or usability testing with affected people.
p3_findings.next_test: Open the default view without interaction and ask readers to identify every population still marked not consulted.

p3_findings.title: History-unavailable caveat was hidden in details
p3_findings.reason: A first-screen state could imply trend meaning while the absence of history required an extra disclosure action.
p3_findings.residual_risk: Visible wording cannot guarantee readers understand the difference between current state and trend evidence.
p3_findings.next_test: Run comprehension testing from the collapsed default view and ask whether the display supports a trend claim.

p3_findings.title: IF-path provenance was present only in embedded JSON
p3_findings.reason: Readers could not see that the projected path was an agent proposal still requiring Fernando's review.
p3_findings.residual_risk: A visible provenance label is still self-asserted and does not record reader comprehension.
p3_findings.next_test: Mutate provenance states and confirm each renders adjacent to the IF claim without relying on embedded JSON.

p3_findings.title: Observatory experiment used a dead state selector
p3_findings.reason: The intended state emphasis never rendered because generated elements and CSS used different class names.
p3_findings.residual_risk: Selector parity proves the rule applies, not that the resulting emphasis is perceptually balanced or accessible.
p3_findings.next_test: Regenerate both arms, inspect the selector against emitted classes and perform a visual contrast review.

p3_findings.title: Round 03 review contained dead and machine-local references
p3_findings.reason: Review evidence links could not be followed from GitHub or pointed to planned files that never existed.
p3_findings.residual_risk: Two explicitly planned references remain non-files by design and future renames can create new link drift.
p3_findings.next_test: Run the repository Markdown-link audit from a clean checkout and inspect all intentionally unresolved references.

p3_findings.title: One-change rule was ambiguous for programme work
p3_findings.reason: An editorial scheduled-run rule could be read as governing multi-component engineering and review work.
p3_findings.residual_risk: A written scope distinction does not itself ensure future commits remain small or reviewable.
p3_findings.next_test: Review future programme commits against declared component boundaries and reject unexplained cross-lane changes.

p3_findings.title: Agent work used Fernando's Git authorship identity
p3_findings.reason: In a provenance-led repository, author metadata should distinguish agent-produced work from Fernando's own commits.
p3_findings.residual_risk: Historical commits remain attributed as originally recorded, and trailers are policy claims rather than cryptographic identity.
p3_findings.next_test: Confirm every new agent-produced commit uses a distinct author and explicit Agent trailer without rewriting retained history.

findings.title: Draft remedy positions lacked capture provenance
findings.reason: The draft presented a softened tax view and portfolio remedy as Fernando's substance without a supporting capture.
findings.residual_risk: Adjacent drafts can still imply that Fernando selected a remedy unless each source and provenance note is reviewed in context.
findings.next_test: Independently trace every first-person remedy, tax, enough-line and enterprise-choice statement to the 2026-09-09 capture or a visible commissioned-proposal label.

findings.title: Frontmatter contract did not cover programme artefacts
findings.reason: The operating manual defined only pipeline types while the programme introduced research, governance, review and protocol types with inconsistent metadata.
findings.residual_risk: A lightweight parser enforces the declared flat contract but does not implement the complete YAML specification or authenticate metadata claims.
findings.next_test: Add malformed YAML, unknown types, missing programme metadata, path-mismatched pipeline IDs and empty source arrays, then run the full communications suite.

findings.title: Public narrative overstated completeness, agency and institutional legitimacy
findings.reason: Several public sentences converted a project definition, one historical series or a proposed participation process into a universal or existing fact.
findings.residual_risk: Local phrase tests cannot prove that readers understand the revised claim ceilings or that disclaimer density is appropriate.
findings.next_test: Run blinded comprehension interviews that ask readers to classify the historical claim, agency definition, participation status and remedy authorship.

findings.title: Freeze CLI returned success for failed or absent reproduction
findings.reason: Receipt integrity and reproduction success are different claims, and the command-line exit status previously collapsed them.
findings.residual_risk: A coherent receipt remains creator-reported evidence and does not prove an independent environment observed the commands run.
findings.next_test: Forge coherent failed and not-run receipts, verify non-zero exits, then reproduce the candidate independently and compare commands, outputs and tree state.

findings.title: Round 06 freeze was unpinned and absent from CI
findings.reason: A modified or resealed Round 06 receipt could merge without a test, workflow check or independently visible expected hash.
findings.residual_risk: CI verification still checks a historical creator receipt while CI test execution is the separate independent observation.
findings.next_test: Change one Round 06 receipt byte, reseal it and confirm the pin test fails; separately confirm CI executes the full command contract on a clean checkout.

findings.title: Pull request is not reviewable as one unit
findings.reason: Hundreds of files and interleaved large commits prevent credible line-by-line review even when the integrated tree is reproducible.
findings.residual_risk: The six sequential diffs are review views rather than independently mergeable products, and the formal-system lane remains large enough to require multiple specialist reviewers.
findings.next_test: Review each pinned component diff independently, repeat every declared and deferred check, and compare the final component tree to the frozen candidate tree.

findings.title: Node runtime contract was not pinned
findings.reason: Local, CI and freeze runs used three Node majors without a declared supported or default runtime contract.
findings.residual_risk: The historical Round 06 creator receipt remains on Node 26 and only a new Round 07 reproduction can demonstrate Node 22 parity.
findings.next_test: Run the complete Round 07 command contract under the pinned Node 22 major and retain the exact runtime in the new receipt.

findings.title: CI drift check ignored untracked files
findings.reason: A builder could emit a newly named file and still pass the tracked-diff-only check.
findings.residual_risk: The shell status check detects repository drift but does not prove builders cannot write outside the checkout.
findings.next_test: Modify a fixture builder to create an untracked file and confirm the workflow-equivalent status command rejects it.

findings.title: Definition revision accepted semantic inversion
findings.reason: A condition could reverse NOT parity, predicate direction or signal identity while retaining the same condition identity.
findings.residual_risk: The semantic equivalence rules cover known expression forms but do not establish philosophical identity for every future predicate type.
findings.next_test: Repeat all three hostile inversions and add nested logical rewrites, then verify split, merge or new identity is required.

findings.title: Predicate failure labels and evaluator identity depended on schema injection
findings.reason: Missing, stale and conflicted states were caller-shaped and schema bytes were absent from the evaluator implementation identity.
findings.residual_risk: A local digest proves code and schema identity, not that observations or the evaluator execution environment are trustworthy.
findings.next_test: Relax schema constants and call exported evaluators directly; missing, stale and conflicted inputs must retain their fixed states and change the evaluator digest.

findings.title: Evaluation clock format and evidence chronology were lax
findings.reason: Equivalent timestamp spellings produced distinct identities and evaluation could predate retained evidence without failing closed.
findings.residual_risk: The evaluator only checks internal chronology; the wall clock and claimed evidence recording times remain unauthenticated.
findings.next_test: Try lax UTC forms, evaluation after bundle as-of and evaluation before the latest retained event, then confirm typed rejection.

findings.title: Post-outcome selective voiding improved forecast scores
findings.reason: A forecast miss could be voided after outcome publication by its author and the cohort remained performance-evaluable.
findings.residual_risk: Outcome publication times and adjudicator identities are still claimed fields without an authenticated external issuer.
findings.next_test: Run the exact five-record attack with an author-adjudicated post-publication void and verify semantics reject it and performance is withheld.

findings.title: Claim assessment failed open on an invalid clock
findings.reason: Date parsing failure bypassed expiry comparisons and allowed expired candidate claims to validate.
findings.residual_risk: A syntactically valid assessment time remains caller-supplied and does not authenticate when review actually occurred.
findings.next_test: Assess an expired claim with missing, malformed and boundary timestamps and require ASSESSMENT_TIME_INVALID or expiry rejection.

findings.title: Frozen NERO baseline could not enter the rehearsal engine
findings.reason: The builder mixed comparison points into a series the engine correctly required to be monthly and contiguous.
findings.residual_risk: Only one real frozen vintage exists, so the repair proves interface coherence rather than historical warning skill.
findings.next_test: Feed the retained baseline through the engine, inject a monthly gap and a blank numeric cell, and confirm only the coherent trailing series is accepted.

findings.title: External governance context omitted positions and dissent
findings.reason: A coordinated deletion and reseal could remove position or dissent identities outside the anti-omission comparison.
findings.residual_risk: The expected external context remains a caller-supplied claim until an independent roster and mandate issuer exists.
findings.next_test: Add and then delete a blocking dissent, position and unresolved identity while resealing every record; exact context coverage must reject each omission.

findings.title: Representative, authority holder and action owner could collapse
findings.reason: One provider could represent affected people, claim authority, own the action and become the only required signer.
findings.residual_risk: Distinct synthetic identifiers do not prove independence, absence of coercion or a valid representative mandate.
findings.next_test: Assign one actor to every governance role and verify negotiation and decision records fail before signature or authority claims are considered.

findings.title: Governance roles carried no closed semantics
findings.reason: Arbitrary role strings passed as long as signatures copied them from the participant entry.
findings.residual_risk: Closed role labels constrain records but do not authenticate that the actor actually holds the named role.
findings.next_test: Replace required representative, candidate-decision-owner and candidate-action-owner roles with invented labels and verify typed rejection.

findings.title: Evaluation receipt freshness was self-asserted without a ceiling
findings.reason: A record author could mint an internally coherent receipt that claimed validity through 2099.
findings.residual_risk: The fixed 30-day ceiling limits exposure but is a local policy choice and still lacks an authenticated issuer.
findings.next_test: Mint receipts at, inside and beyond the 30-day boundary and require strict rejection beyond the cap without treating the cap as authentication.

findings.title: Dated Observatory snapshot was rewritten in place
findings.reason: The index labelled changed 2026-09-07 bytes as the first immutable revision and orphaned the original main-branch bytes.
findings.residual_risk: A corrected local chain preserves byte history but cannot authenticate publisher identity or prove that no earlier unpublished variant existed.
findings.next_test: Verify original main bytes as r1, an explicit r2 correction, exact supersession hashes and a 2026-09-08 correction that points to r2.

findings.title: Observatory failed open when application JavaScript was absent
findings.reason: Hard-coded headline and gate values remained visible when app.js failed, while only missing data.js had a fail-closed path.
findings.residual_risk: DOM harness tests do not replace real browser, assistive-technology, contrast, zoom and failure-path review.
findings.next_test: Block app.js, mutate forecast and gate inputs, and test pending, ready and failed states in real browsers with visual and accessibility inspection.

findings.title: Root README omitted major programme surfaces
findings.reason: The navigation table hid research, integration, options, paths, preparation, experiments, signals and reviews from new readers.
findings.residual_risk: A complete directory map improves discoverability but does not establish an effective reading order for different public audiences.
findings.next_test: Ask unfamiliar readers to locate the thesis, evidence, IF contract, forecast limits, pilot, public prototype and review findings from the root README.

findings.title: Binary and derived artefacts dominate repository weight
findings.reason: Immediate removal would break the retained NERO reproduction chain, while migrating existing history to LFS or generated hosting needs a separately reviewed storage and availability decision.
findings.residual_risk: The branch remains heavy, GitHub file limits are close, and repeated generated HTML can obscure meaningful source review.
findings.next_test: Prototype a clean checkout that reacquires hash-pinned source bytes and builds HTML in CI, then compare reproducibility, offline review and repository size before migration.

findings.title: Review round numbering and status were ambiguous
findings.reason: Round 05 appeared only in prose and the review index still presented Round 03 as the current entry point.
findings.residual_risk: A table records intent but cannot by itself prevent future briefs, freezes and dispositions from drifting out of sequence.
findings.next_test: Add a new review round with a missing brief, freeze or disposition status and verify the repository map makes the omission explicit.
